The '''2022 St Albans City and District Council election''' took place on 5 May 2022, to elect members of [[St Albans City and District Council]] in England.<ref>{{cite web|title=St Albans City and District Council|url=https://www.stalbans.gov.uk/elections-thursday-5-may-2022|access-date=10 April 2022|work=St Albans City and District Council}}</ref> It was on the same day as other [[2022 United Kingdom local elections|local elections]]. 

The whole council was up for election on new boundaries.<ref>{{Cite web|title=LGBCE|work=[[LGBCE]]|url=https://www.lgbce.org.uk/all-reviews/eastern/hertfordshire/st-albans|access-date=10 April 2022}}</ref> At the election, the Liberal Democrats retained control of the council with a greatly increased majority, while Labour were eliminated from the council entirely.<ref>{{Cite web|title=BBC|work=[[BBC]]|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/election/2022/england/councils/E07000240|access-date=13 June 2022}}</ref>
